description: This file defines asynchronous dependency functions for a FastAPI application, utilizing dependency injection with Depends and Annotated to manage resource lifecycles.

methods.name: dependency_a()
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that creates and manages the lifecycle of dep_a, including cleanup in finally block.

methods.name: dependency_b(dep_a: Annotated[DepA, Depends(dependency_a)])
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that depends on dependency_a and manages the lifecycle of dep_b, cleaning up with dep_a as context.

methods.name: dependency_c(dep_b: Annotated[DepB, Depends(dependency_b)])
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that depends on dependency_b and manages dep_c, cleaning up with dep_b as context.
